title: enhanced-canary-shadow-auto-rollback-observability-and-safety-guards
author: Aisha Patel
summary: Add observability, safety guards, and multi-metric thresholds to the unified rollouts autorollback engine for canary + shadow deployments.
description:
Context: We continue hardening unified rollouts: customers have seen unexpected quality regressions during canary/shadow launches when single-metric signals are noisy. This PR extends the autorollback engine with multi-metric quorum checks, improved tracing/metrics for rollout decisions, tighter safety guards for staged/probing phases, and E2E tests to cover common failure modes.

Motivation: Make canary+shadow launches safer and more debuggable by: 1) requiring a quorum of metrics (latency, error-rate, and quality/regression score) before triggering automatic rollback; 2) surfacing rollout decision events in tracing and metrics so SREs can reconstruct why a decision occurred; 3) adding stability guards to prevent flip-flopping on short noisy bursts; 4) improving test coverage with deterministic e2e scenarios.

What this PR changes: checklist:
- [x] Autorollback engine: multi-metric threshold & quorum support (latency_p95, error_rate, reg_score)
- [x] Safety guards: min-observation window, cooldown period, max-rollback-rate
- [x] Observability: rollout_decision counter, rollout_event tracing span, per-model per-stage metrics, debug logs gated by feature flag
- [x] Rollout API: expose last_decision_reason and active_quorum_metrics in status payload (read-only)
- [x] E2E tests: deterministic canary failure, shadow-probing quorum test, stability guard test
- [x] Docs: rollout runbook updates and observability guide

Implementation notes: The autorollback engine was refactored to a small decision pipeline (metric collectors -> aggregator -> quorum evaluator -> actioner). The pipeline is pluggable; we keep backwards compatibility with single-metric policies by treating them as quorum with n=1. We added feature flags to enable the new quorum checks for staged rollouts while we ramp.

Backward compatibility and rollout: defaults preserve existing behavior (single metric) unless linear ticket ENG-1147 flips the feature flag. There is a gradual rollout plan in the release notes.

Testing: unit tests for the decision pipeline, integration tests for metric ingestion, and three new e2e scenarios run in CI. The e2e suite was flaky initially due to timing assumptions; adjusted the probing timing and added wait-for-stable hooks. CI required one rerun of e2e which then passed.

Related: ENG-1147 (quorum thresholds), ENG-1183 (observability rollouts), SUP-4321 (customer incident that motivated multi-metric checks).

release_notes: Enhanced automatic rollback: support multi-metric quorum (latency_p95, error_rate, regression_score).
New observability: rollout_decision metric and rollout_event tracing spans for debugging decisions.
Safety guards: min-observation window, cooldown, and max-rollback-rate to avoid flip-flopping.
API: status now exposes last_decision_reason and active_quorum_metrics (read-only).
No breaking changes by default; feature gated and off-by-default for existing customers.
